mapper.sql: user_id AS userId, google_email AS googleEmail, refresh_token AS refreshToken, scopes, calendar_id AS calendarId, linked_at AS linkedAt, last_synced_at AS lastSyncedAt
mapper.select: SELECT c.user_id AS userId, c.google_email AS googleEmail, c.refresh_token AS refreshToken, c.scopes, c.calendar_id AS calendarId, c.linked_at AS linkedAt, c.last_synced_at AS lastSyncedAt FROM user_google_calendar c JOIN users u ON u.user_id = c.user_id WHERE u.is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_google_calendar (user_id, google_email, refresh_token, scopes, calendar_id, linked_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{googleEmail}, #{refreshToken}, #{scopes}, COALESCE(#{calendarId}, 'primary'), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE google_email = VALUES(google_email), refresh_token = COALESCE(VALUES(refresh_token), refresh_token), scopes = VALUES(scopes), calendar_id = VALUES(calendar_id), linked_at = NOW()
